product_family: Canva is a web-based design platform offering free design tools for education tier (teachers & students), plus paid consumer and enterprise tiers (Pro, Teams, Business, Enterprise). Canva for Education is the free tier for K-12 and higher education.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Canva has attained SOC2 Type II compliance

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Canva is ISO 27001 certified. Canva is regularly audited against ISO 27001 standards by independent third party auditors

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Canva processes your personal data in accordance with European laws and regulations, such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR). DPA contains the EU Standard Contractual Clauses, UK International Data Transfer Addendum

certifications.name: FERPA
certifications.proof_quote: Canva for Education is certified compliant with FERPA. Canva has signed the National Data Privacy Agreement and State-level addenda.

certifications.name: COPPA
certifications.proof_quote: Canva for Education's privacy policies are designed to meet responsibilities under the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) and the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and its compliance has been certified by iKeepSafe

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA certification on Canva's domain

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization on Canva's domain

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification on Canva's domain

privacy.ai_training_note: For free and Pro users: AI training is enabled by default but users can opt out in privacy settings. For Teams, Business, Enterprise, and Education accounts: Content is NOT used to train AI and this cannot be turned on. Education users specifically: student content is never used for AI training.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region (US, Australia, Singapore, EU, UK, Philippines, New Zealand). Enterprise customers can set preferred data residency. AWS-hosted infrastructure.

security.name: Threat Detection
security.value: Logging and alerting systems with oncall teams for incident response

security.name: Data Backup
security.value: Backups stored in geographically-separated location from primary storage

products.name: Canva for Education
products.data_scope: Student designs, collaboration data. Student personal data NOT used for AI training.
products.notes: Free for verified teachers and students. K-12 and higher education. FERPA/COPPA certified. No AI training on student content. LMS integrations with Google Classroom, Canvas, Blackboard, Schoology, D2L, Moodle, Microsoft Teams.

products.name: Canva Free
products.data_scope: User designs and metadata. AI training opt-out available in privacy settings.
products.notes: Free tier with basic design tools

products.name: Canva Pro
products.data_scope: User designs and metadata. AI training opt-out available in privacy settings.

products.name: Canva Teams/Business/Enterprise
products.data_scope: Team/organizational designs. NOT used for AI training (cannot be enabled). SSO, SCIM, role-based access, audit logs.
products.notes: Paid team/organizational tiers with enterprise features including data residency preference

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (Free education tier; Free/Pro individual tiers; Teams/Business/Enterprise organizational tiers)
compare.data_residency: Multi-region AWS (US, Australia, Singapore, EU, UK, Philippines, NZ). Enterprise customers can set preferred region.
compare.ai_training_policy: Tiered: Free/Pro opt-out available. Education/Teams/Business/Enterprise: Never trains on customer content.
